Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient with symptoms of neuropathy during the screening
-  Patient whose Neurological severity score (NSS) score is ≥ 3

right.raw_text: -  Patient whose neurological examination is abnormal  [OR] and suggestive of neuropathy

left.raw_text: -  Patient presenting a pathology that could cause neuropathy (e
